entries.name: Default User Optimizations
entries.description:
Default user profile settings as described in
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/remote/remote-desktop-services/remote-desktop-services-vdi-optimize-configuration
NOTE: This only has effect on new user profiles!
entries.author: John Billekens Consultancy

entries.name: Visual Optimizations
entries.description:
Optimizes performance by disabling many of the Windows visual effects, such as animations and shadows.
IMPORTANT: These settings will only be in-effect for new user profiles. Not existing user profiles.
entries.author: John Billekens Consultancy

entries.name: Default Template
entries.description: The built-in Windows cleanup and optimization template.
entries.author: John Billekens Consultancy
